subject: Re: Kickoff: dot-product vs learned similarity for the recs scorer
body:
Post-sweep wrap-up and decision.

The internal-corpus results came in weaker for learned similarity than even the public numbers suggested: dot-product MF at dim 128 beats the MLP scorer on HR@10 while cutting serving cost an estimated 70% via ANN retrieval. Wanjiru's latency benchmark shows p99 under 12ms versus 41ms for the learned scorer at equivalent recall.

Decision: the memo recommends standardizing the recs scorer on dot-product retrieval, learned similarity reserved for the final-stage ranker only. Draft to Hana Petrov by June 17, final before OKR lock June 26.

One process note: we ended up needing two extra days of cleanup runs after the reserved week; titan-a100 best-effort absorbed it, but next time let's pad the reservation ask.

Good work all.

Dmitri
